text:
Coo-coo, coo-coo! Are you moaning,

turtle-dove of the rice field?

Look, you are doing me

much harm with your song!


Coo-coo, coo-coo! The hamlet

is filling with calm,

and an orange tree and a palm

are kissing in the river...!


Little pitcher filling yourself

with the water of the stream:

How beautiful it is to look at the sky

beneath serene afternoons!


Field lily, dark-skinned girl

who smells of milk and roses:

How happy the soul is

when life is serene...!


Among rosy fineries

the afternoon falls asleep.

Turtle-dove that is moaning:

You are a madrigal with wings!

translation.title: The Turtle-Dove
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the songlike exclamations and the rural tenderness of the original.
